desc: This simple, reliable defensive firearm features just six parts—only two require removal for loading or cleaning—making it exceptionally user‑friendly and virtually foolproof. Crafted with stainless steel internals and firearms‑grade polymer external components, it’s durable, lightweight, and fully ambidextrous. With a smooth double‑action‑only trigger, traditional button safety, additional barrel safety, and integral extractor for fast reloads, this pistol offers peace of mind and straightforward operation. Proudly made in the USA and backed by a lifetime warranty.
